subject: MAP Kickoff: ClarionTech - draft MAP & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cheng <alex.cheng@clariontech.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@clariontech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: ClarionTech - draft MAP & timeline options

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the discovery conversation earlier today. Per our discussion, I’ve attached an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to get us aligned on milestones, owners, dependencies, and a proposed target close date. High level: ClarionTech is a strong fit for Redwood for inference serving (dedicated capacity + security controls) and the MAP below is structured to get the technical review and security approvals completed before contract review and PO.

Please review the draft MAP (attached) and confirm:
- Which timeline option you prefer (Option A = accelerated, Option B = standard)
- Confirm the internal stakeholders who should be listed as owners for each milestone
- Any additional dependencies we missed (e.g., legal/IP addendum, procurement windows)

Draft milestones (summary):
1) Kickoff & MAP finalization — owner: ClarionTech program lead / Redwood AM — target: week 0
2) Technical deep-dive + integration plan — owner: ClarionTech infra + Redwood solutions — target: week 1-2
3) Security & compliance review (SOC 2 evidence + architecture review) — owner: ClarionTech security / Redwood security — target: week 2-4
4) Procurement & contracting (SOW/PO) — owner: ClarionTech procurement / Redwood legal — target: week 4-6
5) Pilot onboarding & validation — owner: ClarionTech infra / Redwood implementation — target: week 5-7

Timeline options (pick one):
- Option A (Accelerated): 6 weeks — Target close date: 2026-07-28 — requires security docs (SOC 2 Type II) available in week 1 and procurement expedited
- Option B (Standard): 10 weeks — Target close date: 2026-08-31 — allows standard procurement review cycles

Dependencies called out in the attached MAP: SOC 2 report (Type II), network/VPC requirements, test dataset access, procurement lead and PO timing, any IP/addendum requests.

Attachments: ClarionTech_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP table + milestones) and NDA-signed.pdf (we have NDA in place). Also linking the MAP in Drive here: https://drive.google.com/clariontech/map/1A2B3C and HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/clariontech/deal/CT-2026-045.

Ask: Can you confirm the ClarionTech stakeholders (program lead + security lead + procurement lead) and which timeline you prefer? If accelerated (Option A), we’ll aim to lock target close 2026-07-28 and will schedule a 30–45 minute MAP review tomorrow or Wednesday to walk through responsibilities.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: ClarionTech - draft MAP & timeline options

Thanks Marissa — appreciated the clear summary and the MAP draft. Priya (cc) is our procurement lead and will own contracting/PO timing. A few quick notes from our side:

1) Stakeholders to include — please add the following ClarionTech owners in the MAP:
   - Sanjay Rao, CTO (sanjay.rao@clariontech.com) — executive sponsor
   - Lydia Park, Dir. of Infrastructure (lydia.park@clariontech.com) — technical owner
   - Priya Singh, Procurement Lead (priya.singh@clariontech.com) — procurement/PO

2) Dependencies — we do need SOC 2 Type II evidence (your SOC 2 pack in week 1 would be ideal) and we also expect to review an IP addendum from legal (I’ll loop legal after this thread).

3) Timeline — we’re interested in Option A (accelerated) if Redwood can support an expedited security review and provide any pre-recorded architecture notes. If Option A, target close 2026-07-28 works for us, assuming security sign-off happens in week 2.

4) Next step — can we schedule a MAP review call? I’m available Wednesday 10:00–11:30 AM PT or Thursday 2:00–4:00 PM PT.

I’ve attached a short ClarionTech risk register excerpt for the team to review before the call.

Best,
Alex

Alex — great, thanks for the rapid reply and the stakeholder list. I’ve noted Sanjay (CTO), Lydia (Infra), and Priya (Procurement) as ClarionTech owners.

We can plan for Option A (accelerated) and aim for 2026-07-28 target close — contingent on SOC 2 evidence in week 1 and legal review of the IP addendum. Rishi (cc) will lead on pricing and will prepare a short pricing addendum to attach to the MAP before contract review.

Proposed MAP review meeting: Wednesday 2026-07-01 at 10:30 AM PT (30 mins) — proposed agenda: 1) review milestones/owners in the attached MAP, 2) confirm security artifact delivery dates, 3) agree contracting path and PO deadlines. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and update the MAP with owners and dependencies.
